selection: First eligible closed UTC hour in each UTC calendar month and BTC regime, chronological order; original A has a position or pending reservation
initial_states: Each policy's independently replayed contemporaneous state; retain cash, positions, pending, day_start, pause_until, losses and protection; report differences, not pure exit causality
existing_pending: Retain and resolve under original next-bar entry and protection semantics
drawdowns: NAV drawdown from replay historical high-water mark
incremental NAV drawdown from simulation starting value
terminal_valuation: Costed executable-proxy mark, separately report still-open positions; never count mark as realized strategy exit
unavailable_behavior: Record missing state/history/conditioned blocks; do not substitute a later favorable start
